name: Particle flow sphere
looks: Around a thousand or more streaks in the brand's colours ride a flowing field across the frame, converge into a sphere of sticks, collapse into concentric dotted rings carrying small readouts, then burst outward around a single dot before the scene leaves on a staircase pixel-block wipe.
build: Draw everything on one 2D canvas from the master clock, precomputing each particle's flow path, its target point on a Fibonacci sphere, its ring position and its start delay once from a seed, then each frame interpolate every particle between its flow, sphere, ring and burst phases with eased progress, drawing short streaked strokes from its previous position.
sound: A whoosh as the streaks converge, a rising shimmer into the sphere, ticks on the rings, a burst hit, and a glitch on the pixel wipe.
prompt: Build a large particle set piece: streaks in the brand's colours flow across the frame, converge into a sphere, collapse into concentric rings with small readouts, then burst outward around a single point before leaving on a staircase wipe. Use it as a striking hook or centrepiece demo that only code can produce.
source: the 2026 Opus showreels; built in examples/reel-2026-10-06.html, S6.
